name: Grimspire Asset Pack
pixel_grid: 32×32 native; multiplied by pixel_scale on export.

title_screen.description: Main menu / title with cathedral backdrop, sigil rings, ember particles.

class_select.description: Vessel/class picker. Portrait cards + stat pips + signature ability.

hud.description: In-game heads-up display. Persistent during exploration + combat.

inventory.description: Pack & vestments grid. Paperdoll on left, item grid center, detail right.

skill_tree.description: Sworn oaths talent tree. Diamond nodes connected by paths.

map.description: Branching dungeon map. Floors arranged left → right with node icons.

loot.description: Three-card boon pick. Mythic / rare / cursed card with rarity ribbon.

pause.description: Pause overlay with cathedral gate bars.

game_over.description: "YOU DIED" run summary. Blood drips, tally panels, rewards earned.

hub_sanctuary.description: Meta-progression between runs. Forge / Altar / Crypt / Merchant / Codex wings.

settings.description: Display / Audio / Controls / Accessibility / About tabs.
